title: CoreWeave Plans 240 MW AI Data Center Campus in Navi Mumbai
description: AI cloud company CoreWeave is entering India through a collaboration with AdaniConneX to develop 240 MW of data center capacity in Navi Mumbai. The planned deployment will be located at AdaniConneX’s Taloja campus and will support CoreWeave’s AI Cloud platform. The project will consist of three buildings, each with 80 MW of capacity. CoreWeave plans to be the sole tenant across the three buildings. The company also intends to establish an Indian office and hire local employees to work with customers and partners. The first phase is expected to become available in mid-2028. Additional capacity will be added in stages. CoreWeave also has the opportunity to expand by another 240 MW at the campus. The company plans to deploy the NVIDIA Vera Rubin Platform at the Taloja site. The infrastructure will support AI training, inference, reasoning and agentic workloads. High-Density AI Computing The Taloja facilities are being designed for high-density AI infrastructure. The buildings will use direct liquid cooling for GPU data halls. A non-evaporative chilled water system will also be used at the campus. CoreWeave said the design is intended to support future generations of AI computing as hardware and workloads evolve. The company is positioning the India expansion as a way to bring specialised computing infrastructure closer to enterprises and AI developers. “India has the talent, developers, and ambition to become a major center of AI innovation,” said Sachin Jain, Chief Operating Officer of CoreWeave. “We are investing in the infrastructure, technology, and local presence needed to support that growth, bringing 240 megawatts of capacity, NVIDIA Vera Rubin, and CoreWeave’s expertise to customers building and scaling AI in India,” he added. The India expansion adds to CoreWeave’s presence across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. The company recently announced its entry into Indonesia. CoreWeave said it had about 4.2 gigawatts of contracted power as of its August 11, 2026 earnings call.
